KeysToEntries.Decoration.ZamorakBanner02.Description: Show off your chaotic whimsy with this lovely banner.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.ZamorakBanner03.Description: Annoy your Saradominist neighbours by displaying this attractive banner.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.GuthixFlag01.Description: Balance your vexillology problems with this handy flag.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.GuthixFlag02.Description: He's dead you know! Mourn him with this lovely flag.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.GuthixFlag03.Description: Reclaim Ashenfall, in the name of Guthix, with this beautiful flag.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.GuthixFlag04.Description: A harmonious green flag, to decorate your home with.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.GuthixFlag05.Description: Show your love for the god of balance with this delightful flag.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.GuthixFlag06.Description: Guthix probably wouldn't have approved of a flag, but he's dead, so go wild!
KeysToEntries.Decoration.GuthixBanner01.Description: Let your friends know that you keen on the green, with this lovely banner.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.GuthixBanner02.Description: Neutrality can be a fashion statement, with this handy banner.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.GuthixBanner03.Description: Balance your feng shui with this harmonious banner.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.ArmadylFlag01.Description: Show that you support justice for everyone, with this handy Armadylian flag.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.ArmadylFlag02.Description: Let the chickens know you're on their side, by displaying this flag to the big bird in the sky.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.ArmadylFlag03.Description: Take pride in displaying your love for the god of Justice, with this attractive flag.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.ArmadylFlag04.Description: Once displayed on floating citadels, you can now display this flag in your very own home.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.ArmadylFlag05.Description: Planting this flag is a rite of passage for some people.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.ArmadylFlag06.Description: Let those who would escape justice, know that they'll find no quarter in your home, with this stunning flag.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.ArmadylBanner01.Description: This banner wards off all sorts of sinister creatures, like lawyers, dentists and narrative designers.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.ArmadylBanner02.Description: Show the chickens you're on their side with this bird-based banner.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.ArmadylBanner03.Description: Let justice be known, with this aesthetically pleasing banner.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.BandosFlag01.Description: The big high war god does  so love a flag. Show your appreciation for him, with one of your own.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.BandosFlag02.Description: Let the goblins know you're one of them, with a flag devoted to their deity of choice.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.BandosFlag03.Description: Let everyone know this is a warrior's home, by placing this delightful flag.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.BandosFlag04.Description: Since you can't have a physical kyzaj, this flag is the next best thing.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.BandosFlag05.Description: Let everyone know that you're down for a fight, with this provocative flag.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.BandosFlag06.Description: Start some trouble by planting this flag in your neighbours garden.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.BandosBanner01.Description: Hang this banner to star a war. There's no mechanical benefit, but it just feels appropriate.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.BandosBanner02.Description: This banner indicates you're ready to rumble.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.BandosBanner03.Description: A banner to the Big High War god. Place it down in your lovely new home.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.SaradominFlag01.Description: A lovely flag, for the more orderly home.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.SaradominFlag02.Description: Praise be to Saradomin! Let this flag be a symbol of your faith.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.SaradominFlag03.Description: If you want to cosplayas a White Knight, then this is the flag for you.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.SaradominFlag04.Description: Dreaming of Falador? This flag is the perfect decoration for you.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.SaradominFlag05.Description: A sign of your devotion to the Lord of Order.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.SaradominFlag06.Description: Decorate your home with this symbol of your faith.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.SaradominBanner01.Description: Hang this banner in front of Zamorakian followers to really annoy them. No mechanical benefit, just for fun.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.SaradominBanner02.Description: Hang this banner to LARP as one of the White Knights.
KeysToEntries.Decoration.SaradominBanner03.Description: Hang this banner to pray for divine intervention. It won't come, but it's at least dramatic.
